g.text: SS-13 Preview and accept a personal roadmap
Apply shared saved-outcome rules (diagram index / FC-07).
Resolve accessible success before new-generation checks:
no generation or extra usage, even at 20 used or during outage.
Permissions, privacy, deletion/expiry and current catalog apply.
[No accessible saved success and new generation cannot proceed]
[Saved success retrieved, or new generation succeeds under FC-07]
[Catalog cannot provide a suitable complete plan]
[Weekly hours and all unfinished-course estimates are available]
[This roadmap is already the Student's active plan]
[Proposal is no longer accessible or eligible]
Recheck at acceptance, including archived unstarted courses.
A revised proposal requires another preview and acceptance.
[Proposal remains eligible and confirmation is current]
Preserve prior course attempts, completions, and badges.
Completed included courses count toward this plan.
Roadmap progress displays 100% only when every
Unstarted courses use latest revision when later started.
Profile or assessment changes do not auto-replace the plan.
